name: Night Horde
hook: Just move. Your weapons do the rest. Survive the night.
how: Walk the graveyard while your weapons fire on their own. Grab the gems monsters drop to level up and pick an upgrade, stand by a downed friend to get them up, and beat the Night Lord at 10:00.
controls: WASD, arrows or hold the mouse to walk, 1/2/3 to pick an upgrade; on touch, drag anywhere to walk and tap a card
uses: Each player's most kills in one night, shown on the results card.
Bots fill the team up to four hunters, each with its own build.
The host's browser runs the horde, the clock and the bots; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Hundreds of monsters chase the team on every screen at once.
ideas: Add a fire bomb weapon that leaves burning ground
Make it a frozen tundra with snow wolves instead of bats
Let players pick a hunter with a different starting weapon
